parameters.name: MaxResults
parameters.description: The maximum number of entries to return when using token-based pagination.

parameters.name: NextToken
parameters.description: The pagination token. Set this parameter to the value of NextToken returned in the previous API call.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The page number in paged queries.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page set in Settings for a paged query during paging.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID. You can call [DescribeRegions](~~354276~~) to query the regions supported by EBS Lens.
